newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Belgo to buy stake in Acominas.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Belgo to buy stake in Acominas.

text.p: Brazilian rolled steel maker Belgo-Mineira said on Wednesday it was planning to buy a 26 percent voting stake in Brazilian steel slabs producer Acominas.
"We will be publishing on Thursday in Brazil's main newspapers a statement telling the market that we have sent Acominas a proposal to buy a 26 percent in the firm," a company spokesman told Reuters.

The spokesman said Belgo-Mineira has sent a proposal to buy stakes in Acominas belonging to Acos Villares SA, BCN bank and Agropecuaria Senhor do Bonfim, which belongs to what was left of failed Banco Economico and is in the Central Bank's hands.
Acominas's minority stockholders, Companhia Vale do Rio Doce and Acominas employees club, will have a preferential period of 30 days to buy the 26 percent voting stock, he said.

Belgo-Mineira hopes that the acquisition of a 26 percent voting stake in Acominas will allow it to acquire troubled steel maker Mendes Junior Siderurgia, which has a mammoth debt of 1.2 billion reais with Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) and Acominas.
Belgo's common stock was quoted at 100 reais before the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) suspended trading in the stock due to the company's announcement.
